summary: Build AssetsBag.com, an ICP portfolio tracker with real market data for crypto, stocks, commodities, and fiat using verified HTTP endpoints; the canister auto-refreshes and caches merged datasets every 2 minutes, supports base-currency conversion, and powers enhanced dashboard analytics (value, P/L, allocation chart).

existing_features.title: Internet Identity login gate and authenticated app shell
existing_features.description: Frontend implements an authentication gate using Internet Identity; unauthenticated users see a login prompt and authenticated users can access the app shell and pages.

existing_features.title: Initial dashboard with empty-state “Add First Asset” call-to-action
existing_features.description: Dashboard shows user holdings list; when portfolio is empty it displays a clear CTA to add the first asset and routes user into the add-asset flow.

existing_features.title: Add Asset flow with market type selection
existing_features.description: Add Asset page allows selecting a market type (Crypto/Stocks/Commodities/Fiat) and proceeds to search/select an asset for adding to the portfolio.

existing_features.title: Asset search with live filtering by ticker or name
existing_features.description: Implements live, type-ahead filtering over an asset catalog; search matches both ticker and asset name (e.g., AAPL or Apple).

existing_features.title: Add holding form (quantity required; purchase price/date optional)
existing_features.description: Form enforces quantity as required; purchase price optional; purchase date optional with default to today; on save, the holding is added to the user’s portfolio.

existing_features.title: Per-user portfolio storage and retrieval (holdings list)
existing_features.description: User portfolios start empty and holdings are stored and loaded per authenticated user; dashboard lists holdings (no charts/allocation breakdown).

existing_features.title: Price refresh cadence placeholder (2-minute target)
existing_features.description: Frontend includes a placeholder mechanism aligned to a 2-minute refresh cadence target, ready to be wired to a real market-data fetcher later.

existing_features.title: Backend authorization and access control scaffolding
existing_features.description: Backend includes authorization/access-control modules to support authenticated user-scoped operations.

existing_features.title: Global light/dark theming with system preference + manual override toggle
existing_features.description: App includes a global theming system supporting light and dark themes. Theme can follow system preference by default, with a manual toggle to override; the manual override takes precedence across the app.

existing_features.title: User profile setup dialog/scaffolding
existing_features.description: Frontend includes profile setup dialog and user-profile hook/scaffolding to manage basic per-user profile state during onboarding/authenticated use.

existing_features.title: Pre-login landing/login homepage separated from post-login dashboard
existing_features.description: Unauthenticated users now see a dedicated pre-login landing/login screen; authenticated users are routed directly to the app dashboard/shell without duplicating marketing/landing content.

existing_features.title: Backend market-data fetcher with verified HTTP endpoints + merged asset cache
existing_features.description: Backend integrates the fixed, verified HTTP endpoints for crypto (4 workers), stocks (4 workers), fiat, and commodities; crypto & stocks are merged across all 4 endpoints and sorted by marketCap DESC; fiat & commodities preserve endpoint order. Result is stored as a unified cached dataset for frontend search/add-asset flows.

existing_features.title: Automated 2-minute canister background refresh with last-good-cache fallback
existing_features.description: Canister runs fully automated background updates on a ~2-minute cadence: fetch all endpoints, rebuild merged cache, persist with timestamp; if any endpoint fails, the canister keeps the last known-good cache and logs silently without user-facing errors.

existing_features.title: Modernized UI styling with Shadcn UI + Tailwind component system
existing_features.description: App UI styling and component set updated to a cleaner modern design using a Shadcn UI/Tailwind-based component library (buttons, dialogs, tables, navigation, etc.) consistently across pages and flows.

existing_features.title: Backend access-control initialization method compatible with immutable frontend call
existing_features.description: Backend exposes a public method `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret(adminToken : Text) : async ()` to initialize/activate access control in a way that matches the immutable frontend initialization call path, preventing deploy/runtime failures due to missing method.

existing_features.title: FIAT-only Step 3 slice: VPS1 fx_rates fetch+validate+in-memory store with inspection query + frontend test hook/page
existing_features.description: Backend implements a minimal FIAT-only Step 3 flow that (a) permission-gates a dedicated update method to fetch `http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json`, (b) validates response deterministically (non-empty + basic JSON shape), (c) stores the latest validation result in non-stable memory including URL, timestamp, raw body (with max-size cap and truncation), and valid/invalid + error, and (d) exposes a permission-gated query method to inspect the latest stored result without triggering a new outcall. Frontend adds a corresponding hook/test page for inspecting FIAT VPS1 results.

existing_features.title: When the user selects the “Fiat” market type on AddAssetPage, load the FIAT currencies list from the backend-cached VPS1 endpoint (via the existing backend methods fetchFiatVPS1Data() + getFiatVPS1ValidationResult()) and render those currencies inside the existing Add‑Asset search results list (replacing the current static fiatCatalog list while data is available). Parse the JSON body returned from http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json and map each rates entry into an Asset object: marketType=fiat, ticker=countryCode (e.g., "ABW"), name=countryName (e.g., "Aruba, Kingdom of the Netherlands").

Add a frontend data hook (or extend existing hooks) so that entering the Fiat market type automatically triggers a fetch/refresh of the VPS1 FIAT cache by calling fetchFiatVPS1Data(), then reads getFiatVPS1ValidationResult() and keeps the parsed FIAT Asset list in React Query cache for use by AssetSearch. Ensure loading and error states are handled in the Add‑Asset search UI without blocking other market types.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add base currency support: USD default plus user-selectable fiat dropdown with instant conversion using cached FX rates (rateUSD semantics).

Enhance dashboard: total portfolio value, total P/L (color-coded), allocation pie chart by market type, expanded holdings table ([Logo] Asset | Market | Qty | Current Price | Value | P/L | % Portfolio), plus footer with last-updated timestamp and base currency selector.

Enforce search ordering and display rules: crypto & stocks sorted by marketCap DESC; fiat & commodities preserve endpoint order; show results as [Logo(if available)] Symbol • Name • Market Type; match by ticker or name.

Perform a clean rebuild of the full project (frontend + backend) and identify the exact cause of the canister deployment failure (e.g., Motoko compile error, missing module/import, candid/interface mismatch, wasm size/limits) related to the new multi-VPS data-pipeline integration.

Adjust the multi-VPS data-pipeline integration implementation so that the backend canister compiles and deploys successfully under the platform constraints (single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo, no unsupported external services, and within canister limits).
Break the multi-VPS data-pipeline integration into smaller implementation steps and apply/validate them one-by-one to simplify integration and deployment troubleshooting.

In `backend/main.mo`, add four dedicated backend update methods to fetch external market data by category—one each for crypto, stocks, fiat, and commodities—implemented as separate functions (not a single generic fetch) and using the existing `OutCall.httpGetRequest(..., transform)` verified HTTP-call pattern.

Restrict outbound requests for the new per-market fetch methods to a hardcoded, verified allowlist of HTTPS endpoints (one list per market category or a combined allowlist keyed by market category). The methods must reject any URL that is not explicitly allowlisted (including non-HTTPS URLs), ensuring the canister cannot be used as an arbitrary open proxy.

Update or replace the existing `fetchExternalData(url : Text)` method so that it is no longer a general-purpose arbitrary-URL fetch for normal users. Align it with the new safety model (e.g., remove it, restrict it to admins, or make it route through the same allowlist verification), and ensure the backend Candid interface matches the implemented methods to prevent deploy/interface mismatches.
Step 3: Validate all market-data endpoint responses independently (crypto/stocks/fiat/commodities) and store the raw/validated results temporarily in memory for inspection before merging/caching.

In `backend/main.mo`, add in-memory, non-stable storage for per-market endpoint validation results (crypto, stocks, fiat, commodities). Each stored result must include: the requested allowlisted URL, a timestamp, the raw HTTP response body (Text), and a validation status (valid/invalid) with an error message when invalid.

In `backend/main.mo`, implement dedicated backend update methods to validate endpoint responses independently for each market category (crypto/stocks/fiat/commodities). Each validation method must: (1) enforce the existing access-control permission checks, (2) reject any URL not in the existing hardcoded HTTPS allowlist for that market, (3) perform the HTTP GET using the existing `OutCall.httpGetRequest(..., transform)` pattern, (4) validate the returned response body using deterministic checks (e.g., non-empty and basic JSON shape checks such as starting with '{' or '[' after trimming), and (5) store the raw/validated result in the corresponding in-memory buffer.

In `backend/main.mo`, expose query methods to inspect the latest stored validation results for each market category (crypto/stocks/fiat/commodities) without triggering new HTTP outcalls. Access to these inspection query methods must be permission-gated consistently with the existing access-control model.

architectural_notes: Target price refresh cadence: every 2 minutes (implement as configurable polling schedule when fetcher exists).
Add-asset form fields: quantity required; purchase price optional; purchase date optional (defaults to today); on save, add holding to user portfolio.
User portfolios start empty; store holdings per-user (no initial seeded holdings).
Authentication uses Internet Identity; portfolio operations are scoped per authenticated user principal.
Theming: support both system-preference auto theme and a manual light/dark toggle (manual override takes precedence).

Market-data providers/endpoints are now fixed: crypto workers http://74.208.158.232/crypto_worker_0.json, http://87.106.37.86/crypto_worker_1.json, http://87.106.143.214/crypto_worker_2.json, http://217.160.21.18/crypto_worker_3.json; stocks workers http://74.208.158.232/stocks.json, http://87.106.37.86/stocks.json, http://87.106.143.214/stocks.json, http://217.160.21.18/stocks.json; fiat http://74.208.158.232/fx_rates.json; commodities http://74.208.158.232/commodities.json.
Crypto & stocks datasets must be merged across all 4 endpoints and sorted by marketCap descending to drive UI search; fiat & commodities are not sorted (use natural endpoint order).
Canister runs fully automated background updates every 2 minutes: fetch all endpoints, rebuild cache, store with timestamp; no manual refresh.

Deployment troubleshooting artifacts added: follow `frontend/docs/rebuild-checklist.md` for clean rebuild steps and `frontend/docs/deploy-failure-root-cause.md` for the current deploy-failure investigation notes.
UI component system standardized on Shadcn UI + Tailwind (shared UI primitives under frontend/src/components/ui/*).

Need to define/confirm maximum safe size/retention for in-memory raw HTTP response buffers to avoid exceeding canister memory limits.
